# Bundled local GIF reactions

Animated Noto Emoji by Google, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution4.0
International (CC BY4.0). Source/license announcement:
https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-files/?view=docs
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The full legal code is in CC-BY-4.0.txt.

Each manifest entry records the official Google Fonts CDN URL, original bytes/SHA,
and packaged bytes/SHA. Original source GIFs are preserved in originals/. Lip adds
an attribution comment only; visual frames are unchanged. The same attribution is
visible in the keyboard, carried in the GIF comment, and supplied as content label/
source link when an editor accepts the GIF. No endorsement by Google is implied.

This is a pinned, small offline reaction catalog—not the full Noto collection or
an online GIF search service. The app does not fetch GIFs or send search queries.
